en: THREE ISLAND\nKin Island of Family Bonding
Hyahoo!\pFrom this day on, this island\nbelongs to us!
We don't need you people bringing\nyour noise and trouble here!\pWe're asking you to go back to\nKANTO!
Hey, go cry somewhere else.\nOur boss is on his way.\pWhen he gets here, we'll give you\na k-rad motorbike show you won't\lsoon forget!
W-what!? Not on your life!\nGet off the island now!
Who's gonna make me?
Are you the boss?\nGo back to KANTO right now!
Hah?\pI just got here, pal.\pWhat's with the hostile attitude?\nIt's mighty cold of you!
Your gang of followers have been\nraising havoc on their bikes.\pDo you have any idea how much\ntrouble they've caused us on the\lisland?

No, man, I don't get it at all.\pLook at this place.
What do you do for entertainment?\pYou ought to be thanking us for
livening up this sleepy village.\pBut hey, if you insist, you can try
making us leave.
Grr… You cowards…\nSo tough in a pack…
You, what are you staring at?\nDon't you know it's not polite?\pYou wanna make something of it\nor what?
That's smart.\nKeep your nose out of this.
Heh, I like your guts.\nYou'll be losing money to me, but…
Wha…\nWhat is this kid?!
Aww, man…\nDon't you dare laugh!
Aren't you from KANTO?\nYou should be on our side!
Stop fooling around!
What's the matter with you,\ngetting all hot like that?\pTotally uncool, man!
We invited the boss out here,\nbut you had to mess it up!\pYou embarrassed us, man!
Boss, I'm telling you, you've gotta\ndo something about this kid!

I've been watching you, and I'd say
you've done enough.\pWhat are you, their friend or
something?\pThen I guess you'll be battling me
in their place.
All right, enough!\nWe'll leave like you wanted!\pWe'll be happy to see the last of\nthis boring island!
Humph! Yeah, go right on hanging\naround with these hayseeds!
Thank you! Those goons were\nnothing but bad trouble.\pOh, look, your POKéMON got hurt\non my account.
{PLAYER} was given\na FULL RESTORE.
Oh?\nYour BAG is full.
You've got seriously impressive\nPOKéMON with you.

It'd be fantastic if someone as
strong as you lived here.\pI hope you'll at least stay here
a while.\p…I beg your pardon?
You're looking for LOSTELLE?\pLOSTELLE went off towards BOND
BRIDGE a while ago.
THREE ISLAND is actually the most\npopulous of the islands here.\pStill, it could be less sleepy.\pBut I wouldn't want to see goons\nlike those BIKERS here again.
I'm going to train my DODUO in the\nBERRY FOREST.\pWhen it evolves, I'm going to play\na game on TWO ISLAND.
DODUO: Gigiih!
